rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is proposed; §10 consolidates the sprint-focus answer behind the existing `focus_sprint_id` derivation rather than adding a parallel one, and §8 extends the existing `Followup` dataclass in place.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §10 proposes a new shared `active_sprint_id` derivation while `reckon/project_state.py:1277 focus_sprint_id` already exists and `reckon/roadmap.py:1988` already consumes it, and §7's roadmap coverage duplicates `reckon/flight.py:1977 _path_coverage`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 1470, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §7 adds a roadmap `coverage` field and §8 adds a followup `kind` field plus an audit finding, neither naming what it retires or merges.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §3/§7 adds a roadmap `coverage` field without citing `reckon/flight.py:1977 _path_coverage`, which already computes coverage and uncovered critical hours from live pointers, and §8 adds a followup `kind` without citing `reckon/followup_pointers.py:105 classify_followup`, the existing text classifier over followups.
